npcs.name: Nell
npcs.opening: There. Hear that little phrase? Wait for him to sing it again.
npcs.returnLine: I kept the bit where we both heard it. You can hear you smiling.
npcs.keepsake: A labelled recording for the field journal
npcs.placeNote: A path just inside Bursted Woods

npcs.name: Kit
npcs.opening: If you see it, just point. Last time someone shouted, it flew off.
npcs.returnLine: It came back. Different hat today. I'm testing a theory.
npcs.placeNote: The scrubby edge of Bursted Woods

npcs.name: Imani
npcs.opening: Same bird in both drawings. Reckon you can name it from the way it climbs?
npcs.returnLine: That one's yours to finish. I've left you the interesting bit.
npcs.keepsake: A copy of her nuthatch study

npcs.name: Bea
npcs.opening: Built that window specially for kingfishers. So far it's been excellent for looking at a crisp packet.
npcs.returnLine: Typical. I was getting the drill.

options.label: A low window, close to the water
A window at eye level, halfway along
A high window, looking over the reeds

npcs.name: Dev
npcs.opening: First week at the bakery I thought that blackbird was someone's alarm going off. Felt a right idiot when I asked whose phone it was.
npcs.returnLine: You heard it that time. Same one, just before the fan came back on.
npcs.keepsake: A bakery order slip with the bird rhythm on the back

npcs.name: Moss
npcs.opening: Best view I've ever had of a jay. Absolutely filled the frame. This is the branch about half a second later.
npcs.returnLine: Put the whole thing up in the hide. Your initials are on it. You found the bird.
npcs.keepsake: A photograph with the crop marked in pink
npcs.placeNote: A fallen tree in Bursted Woods

npcs.name: June
npcs.opening: Seven long-tailed tits went across. If you're about to say eight, you'd better have seen something I didn't.
npcs.returnLine: Season champion. Give it here if I win next week.

npcs.name: Otis
npcs.role: The keeper of his sister's map
npcs.opening: She's put the star in the wrong place. Well. She's seven. Let's go to the wrong place, then.
npcs.returnLine: She's asking if you've been back to Waggy Bridge. Apparently it needs checking every Sunday.

npcs.name: Ruth
npcs.role: The last one in the wood
npcs.opening: You can sit there. That end dries first.
npcs.returnLine: There you are. Wondered when you two would meet.

npcs.name: Val
npcs.role: The driver who knows the parakeets' timetable
npcs.opening: Used to drive the 89 through here. Everyone upstairs looking down at their phones. Best seats in the house, absolutely wasted.
npcs.returnLine: After work. Theirs, usually. Mine's all over the place.
npcs.keepsake: An old duty card with the flight line drawn on its back
npcs.placeNote: A bus stop on Erith Road beside Bursted Woods

npcs.name: Alfie
npcs.role: The keeper who wants a witness
npcs.opening: Please tell my brother you saw it. Green bird, red head, practically on the penalty spot. He reckons I'm making excuses for the third goal.
npcs.returnLine: Bird confirmed. Still should've saved it.
npcs.placeNote: The open grass beside Bursted Woods

npcs.name: Leanne
npcs.opening: Got asked for 'seagull grey' at work. I said, which bit? She's looking at me like I've asked which seagull. Well. That as well.
npcs.returnLine: Someone asked for your colour yesterday. By name. Had to get the card out to check it.
